title: The Tabernacle, the Temple and the Body of Christ
subtitle: Every part of God's house, from the gate to the mercy seat, and how Christ, His church and heaven itself answer to it
summary: "Let them make Me a sanctuary, so that I may dwell among them" (Exodus 25:8). The tent in the wilderness and the temple that followed it were built to a pattern shown on the mountain, and the New Testament says what the pattern was: the Word who tabernacled among us, the church built into a holy temple, and the true sanctuary in heaven. This study walks in from the gate, part by part.
